claims: A Falcon 9 successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA, on April 6, 2026.
The Falcon 9 launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA on April 6, 2026 occurred at 7:50 p.m. PDT.
The first stage of the Falcon 9 landed on a droneship during the launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA on April 6, 2026.
A Falcon 9 is set to launch a Dragon spacecraft from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, FL, on April 9, 2026.
The Dragon spacecraft will deliver 6,000+ pounds of supplies to the ISS.
A Falcon 9 completed a record 34th flight of a first-stage booster for a Starlink mission on March 30, 2026.
Falcon 9 launch sites are primarily Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida and Vandenberg Space Force Base in California.
